name: adlc-next
description: ADLC skills that carry a delegated software task through to its delivery point, with design, work-item, and method-improvement skills around it.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate a software task once and get it carried through.
interface.longDescription: ADLC Next packages skills in four groups. SDLC skills own a delegated task from investigation to the requested delivery point (solve, implement, review, clarify, handoff, test-first, bugfix, ship); ADS skills settle requirements, architecture, domain rules, and specs; tasks skills turn inputs into ordered work items and wrap up batches; improvement skills turn recurring friction into placed fixes and evaluate skills and prompts. A shared task file keeps paused and handed-off work resumable.
defaultPrompt: Use $adlc-next:sdlc-solve to fix this bug and verify the result.
Use $adlc-next:sdlc-review to review the current branch against its task.
Use $adlc-next:adlc-router to find which ADLC skill fits this request.
